caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden bench placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The bench is rectangular with a flat top surface showing visible wood grain texture in various shades of brown. The top panel of the bench has straight edges and slightly rounded corners, with two square joints or inlays visible near each end. The bench is supported by two wide, solid legs at either end, shaped with inward curves and angles, and connected by a horizontal stretcher bar just below the seat. The joints and structural details of the wooden bench are highlighted in darker and lighter brown tones, emphasizing the natural look and construction of the furniture piece. There are no additional objects or patterns in the composition, and the scene is devoid of any background details except for the neutral backdrop. In the lower right corner, small, handwritten text is visible.
title: Moravian Church Bench
